boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Saint Francis spaces for studying, creating, playing, gathering, reflection, and campus involvement.

cards.title: John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for meeting, studying, performances, and student services
cards.notes: Use the central hub to meet a group, catch a performance, study, or connect with student-engagement staff before planning an event or joining an organization.
cards.short_summary: A multi-use campus gathering point with spaces for both social time and focused work.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the JFK Student Center as a central hub for meeting friends, live entertainment, food, quiet study, and student services.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The university’s event listing gives the address as 117 Evergreen Drive and lists the building as open 24/7; follow campus access policies.

cards.title: JFK Multipurpose Lounge
cards.subtitle: Inside the John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Bring a small group for a meeting or study session, or check the center’s programming before using the lounge for a presentation or gathering.
cards.short_summary: A flexible lounge set up for group meetings, studying, talks, and dances.
cards.evidence_claim: The JFK Student Center’s multipurpose lounge is designated for small or large group meetings, studying, speakers, presentations, and dances.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Located within the JFK Student Center; availability can vary with scheduled events.

cards.title: DIY Craft Room
cards.subtitle: Lower level, John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Plan a simple sign or project with the room’s listed craft supplies, then return materials neatly so the next group can use the space.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on campus room stocked for making signs and other small creative projects.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the JFK lower level includes a DIY Craft Room with supplies such as paint, paper, and pom poms.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Located in the JFK Student Center lower level; confirm access or programming with the center.

cards.title: Luke Trotz Esports Arena
cards.subtitle: Lower level, John F. Kennedy Student Center
cards.notes: Stop in for a casual game or ask Student Engagement about esports opportunities; the university describes the arena as serving both competitive and casual gamers.
cards.short_summary: A named gaming space with equipment for campus esports and casual play.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Luke Trotz Esports Arena as featuring equipment for competitive and casual gamers.
cards.source_title: JFK Student Center | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: The arena is in Lower JFK; university orientation materials state it is open to students during the semester.

cards.title: Pasquerilla Library
cards.subtitle: Library and Learning Commons
cards.notes: Choose a quiet study room, open study area, computer lab, or group room based on the work you need to finish, and check library rules before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A four-floor learning commons with technology, study areas, and research resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis lists group study and seminar rooms, electronic classrooms, a computer lab, and the Archives in Pasquerilla Library.
cards.source_title: Library | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Library services and room availability are subject to university policies and schedules.

cards.entity_name: Margaret M. Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections
cards.title: Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections
cards.subtitle: Inside Pasquerilla Library
cards.notes: Visit the archives to explore university records and special collections; begin with a focused research question and ask library staff how to request materials.
cards.short_summary: The library’s archive and special-collections center preserves Saint Francis records and historical collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis identifies the Margaret M. Tobin Center for Archives and Special Collections as home to University archives and records plus several special collections.
cards.source_title: Library | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Located in Pasquerilla Library; handling and access to archival materials follow library procedures.

cards.entity_name: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health and Wellness
cards.title: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health and Wellness
cards.subtitle: Health, wellness, learning, and community services
cards.notes: Use the institute as a starting point for wellness resources or health-science learning, and contact the relevant center directly for appointments or program details.
cards.short_summary: A campus wellness and health-sciences facility that includes specialized centers and learning spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis says the DiSepio Institute houses specialized wellness centers and provides health-promotion and rehabilitation services to the university community.
cards.source_title: DiSepio Institute for Rural Health & Wellness | Saint Francis University
cards.access_notes: Services and facilities have their own eligibility and appointment requirements.

cards.title: Maurice Stokes Athletic Center
cards.subtitle: Athletics, fitness, recreation, and the Stokes Pool
cards.notes: Check the current facility schedule before heading over for recreation or a team event, and carry your university ID if campus staff request it.
cards.short_summary: A major campus athletics facility with arena, pool, gymnasium, and sports-support spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis states that the Stokes Athletic Center includes DeGol Arena, the Natatorium, auxiliary gymnasium, sports medicine, and other athletics spaces.
cards.source_title: Athletic Facilities | Saint Francis University Policies Portal
cards.access_notes: Saint Francis states the facility is open to enrolled students, faculty, staff, and retired faculty/staff; users may be asked for university ID.

cards.title: Immaculate Conception Chapel
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry worship and prayer space
cards.notes: Visit for scheduled worship or a quiet prayer break; consult Campus Ministry’s current calendar if you are planning around a specific service or fellowship event.
cards.short_summary: The renovated campus chapel hosts worship, confession, and prayer access.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes the Immaculate Conception Chapel as hosting daily Mass, frequent confession, and 24/7 prayer access before the tabernacle.
cards.access_notes: Saint Francis states there is 24/7 access for prayer; scheduled liturgies and fellowship events have separate times.

cards.title: Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto
cards.subtitle: Campus Ministry outdoor reflection site
cards.notes: Take the path for a calm outdoor reflection stop, keeping the setting quiet and checking Campus Ministry information if a service is planned there.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus grotto intended for private prayer and reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Saint Francis describes its Our Lady of Lourdes Grotto as a replica shrine whose quiet natural setting supports private prayer and reflection.
cards.access_notes: Mass and Eucharistic adoration are occasionally celebrated at the grotto; check Campus Ministry’s live schedule for events.
